The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Assesses attack surface first and concludes dynamic scanning applies, since this is a deployed API with a Dockerfile
- Proposes dependency, static and dynamic scanning, not just one
- Proposes the change as a pull request, not a direct commit to the default branch
- Names any secret the user must add (such as a scanner API key) rather than inventing a value

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
